ownership.parent: Alphabet Inc. (Google Cloud / GKE product line)
ownership.quote: Agent Sandbox is a Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE) native solution... GKE pricing applies to the resources that you create.

stage.note: GKE Agent Sandbox is a feature of Google Kubernetes Engine, offered as part of Google Cloud, a segment of the publicly traded Alphabet Inc. (NASDAQ: GOOGL, IPO 2004). It is not an independently funded company; no separate funding history applies.

revenue.basis: Alphabet Inc. full-year 2025 consolidated revenue (S&P Global Market Intelligence data via stockanalysis.com, reflecting Alphabet's reported financials); Google Cloud segment revenue for FY2025 was $77,617,000,000. GKE Agent Sandbox itself has no separately disclosed revenue.

note: GKE Agent Sandbox is a feature within Google Kubernetes Engine (Google Cloud), not an independent company or startup — it has no separate funding, accelerator, or revenue history. Ownership/stage/revenue figures given here are for the parent, publicly traded Alphabet Inc. (Google Cloud is one of Alphabet's reporting segments, FY2025 segment revenue $77.6B; total Alphabet FY2025 revenue $402.8B).
